abilities.label: BATTLECRY
abilities.span: Battlecry: Get 2 random 'Journey to Un'Goro' Quest Rewards. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

dependencies.detail: the exact list of 'Journey to Un'Goro' Quest Rewards (one reward per Un'Goro Quest; the snapshot has 9 UNGORO Quests and no quest-to-reward link); 'the rest' needs the full list
dependencies.source_needed: reviewed manifest of the reward cards

decisions.question: The pool constraint 'Quest Rewards' has no IR predicate: is the pool 'any UNGORO card'?
alternatives: no: membership is the manifest of the 9 reward cards; card_set UNGORO is only a necessary filter
decisions.chosen: no: membership is the manifest of the 9 reward cards; card_set UNGORO is only a necessary filter
decisions.discriminating_case: found in the review of the rendered IR: without the manifest an executor would draw any of 232 UNGORO records

decisions.question: 'the rest' = every other reward of the list, one copy each?
decisions.discriminating_case: deck size change after the Battlecry in a log

decisions.question: If a gotten reward burns (full hand), is it still excluded from 'the rest'?
